Backend: 16 new tests in test_security_card.py all PASS (audit/summary shape across all range keys, deletions sum, requires-auth, secret.copied requires-auth, 404 on unknown secret, audit row content + critical secret-value-leak guard, summary counts roll-up, /audit/meta refresh). action_items: (carry-over from iter 4, none introduced this iter) Dedupe users in /api/audit/meta or change AuditLog SelectItem key=u.user_id||u.username to remove 'duplicate key admin' React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SecurityCard /audit/summary fetch uses an empty catch ({}) — silently swallows network/server errors and shows a permanently calm card. Consider surfacing a tiny error pill so admins notice when audit pipeline breaks.
audit_routes._range_bounds duplicates dashboard_routes._range_bounds verbatim; pull into a shared util to keep range semantics consistent (DRY) — already flagged iter 4.

Pre-existing carry-overs still open: CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True (invalid per CORS spec); deprecated @app.on_event lifecycle (use FastAPI lifespan); /api/auth/change-password rejects new_password==DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD globally — should only apply to the seeded admin account.
JobDetail Copy handler is fire-and-forget (`api.post(...).catch(noop)`) — good for UX, but a failed audit POST is silent; a debug console.warn would help triage.

secret_routes.log_secret_copied uses positional `$` projection on `secrets.id` — works, but `.find_one` with `{ "secrets.$": 1 }` is fine; the 404 path correctly distinguishes 'no job + matching secret', so unknown job_id also returns 404 (semantically merged with unknown secret). Acceptable but worth a comment.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Security card feature is production-ready. Two complementary test files cover audit: test_audit_new.py (filters/meta/file.viewed) and test_security_card.py (summary shape across ranges + secret.copied pipeline). The secret-value-leak guard test is the load-bearing one — please keep it. SecurityCard fetches /audit/summary?range=day on mount; if backend errors, card silently shows calm state.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing flows. Notes: (1) Login redirects to '/' (root) which renders Dashboard, not '/dashboard'; future Playwright scripts should use wait_for_function or check for [data-testid="dashboard-security-card"] instead of URL match. (2) Frontend SecurityCard correctly drops cancel-on-unmount via the closure-captured `cancel` flag — no leaked state updates on rapid nav.
